card.text: A 1.94-Earth-radius planet with a 30.79-day year in HD 110067's resonant chain.

introduction.text: HD 110067 e is one of six transiting sub-Neptunes. Its radius is 1.940 Earth radii and its year lasts 30.79 days.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the measured radius. Neutral gray marks the unknown surface colour; lighting comes from the host star.
